components.description: A component records how Bitcoin flowed between several of your wallets in one step, for example one send into three wallets, or a migration through a wallet you no longer have.
components.listDescription: Versioned interpretations currently recorded for this book. An authored active component remains a draft for accounting if its complete evidence set no longer validates.
components.moreAvailable_one: Showing the newest {{count}} component. More exist in this book; narrow the review scope to inspect older revisions.
components.moreAvailable_other: Showing the newest {{count}} components. More exist in this book; narrow the review scope to inspect older revisions.
components.empty: No components yet. You only need one when a simple link can't describe what happened.

title.undo: Restore this revision as a draft?

description.activate: Checked against your book. Confirming makes this revision the active interpretation and supersedes any other active revision of this component.
description.retire: Checked against your book. Confirming retires this draft. It stays in the audit trail and can be restored later with Undo.
description.supersede: Checked against your book. Confirming supersedes this component, so it is no longer the active interpretation. It stays in the audit trail and can be restored later with Undo.
description.undo: Checked against your book. Confirming saves this revision's content as a new draft revision. Nothing becomes active until you activate the draft.

revisionDialog.description: Edits create a new immutable revision. The previous record stays in the audit trail; activating the revision atomically replaces the active interpretation.

localIssue.allocationSinkCoverage: Component {{component}}, sink leg {{leg}} has allocation coverage {{covered}}; expected {{expected}}.

form.title: Build a custody component
form.description: Describe how Bitcoin moved between your wallets — including any wallet history not imported into Kassiber — as source, destination, and fee legs. Kassiber checks that the amounts balance before you save.
form.evidenceKindHint: Short, stable code for the kind of evidence you reviewed, for example manual_migration_review. It is stored with the component.

sections.interpretationHint: What kind of custody movement this is and how its amounts must balance.
sections.evidenceHint: Recorded with the component so a later reviewer can see why this interpretation exists.

form.notesPlaceholder: What does this component record, and why?
form.legsHint: Add one leg per movement: where the Bitcoin left, where it arrived, and any fee.

leg.suspenseHint: A suspense leg records value in limbo — no wallet or transaction, only a time. Add an allocation from its funding source below.

balance.title: Movement summary
balance.difference: Destinations and fees differ from the sources by {{amount}}.

allocations.title: Allocations
allocations.hint: Map exactly how much of each source funds each destination, fee, or retained leg. Required for multi-source, conversion, and suspense components.
allocations.empty: No allocations yet. Add one edge per source → destination flow.

form.previewChanged: The form or active book changed. Preview again before confirming.
form.unsupportedShape: This component cannot be edited safely in the guided builder. Review its evidence and use the CLI for unsupported component shapes.

review.title: Review before you confirm
review.activates_one: Checked against your book. Confirming activates this component.
review.activates_other: Checked against your book. Confirming activates {{count}} components.
review.drafts_one: Checked against your book. Confirming saves this component as a draft.
review.drafts_other: Checked against your book. Confirming saves {{count}} components as drafts.

components.newDescription: Describe where the Bitcoin left, where it arrived and any fee. Kassiber checks that the amounts balance and shows the result before anything is saved.

page.swapsDescription: Review likely non-Bitcoin asset swaps before linking them as taxable swaps.
page.transfersDescription: Review wallet-to-wallet transfers and Bitcoin swaps across Lightning, Liquid, and on-chain rails.
page.swapsEmpty: No unlinked asset-swap candidates. If non-Bitcoin swaps show up later, they will appear here.
page.transfersEmpty: No unlinked Bitcoin movement candidates. Wallet transfers, Boltz swaps, pegs, and refunds show up here.
page.allDescription: Every suggested move between your wallets, Bitcoin swaps and swaps into another asset, with filters. A swap into another asset carries a Different asset chip and is taxable unless you choose otherwise.
page.allEmpty: No unlinked candidates. Wallet transfers, Boltz swaps, pegs, refunds and asset swaps show up here.
page.focusEmpty: No other receipt matches this send. If it was your own move, go back and link it back; if it went to a wallet Kassiber doesn't know yet, connect that wallet first.

paired.swapsDescription: Non-Bitcoin asset swaps you've already linked. Open one to change its kind or policy, or unlink it.
paired.transfersDescription: Wallet moves and Bitcoin swaps you've already linked with carrying-value treatment. Open one to change its kind or policy, or unlink it.
paired.swapsEmpty: No linked swaps yet. Swaps you confirm from the suggestions show up here.
paired.transfersEmpty: No linked transfers yet. Transfers you confirm from the suggestions show up here.
paired.sameAssetTaxableHint: Same-asset transfers stay carrying-value — taxable isn't available.
paired.unpairBody: The two sides count on their own again and reappear in the suggestions. Journal and tax deltas are recomputed on the next journal recalculation.
paired.allDescription: Wallet moves, Bitcoin swaps and swaps into other assets you've linked. Open one to change its kind or policy, or unlink it.
paired.allEmpty: No linked moves yet. Moves you confirm from the suggestions show up here.

savedView.title: Saved views
savedView.explain: Views you saved earlier. Opening one filters the suggestions.
savedView.empty: No saved views yet. Filter the matching tools and choose Save view.

rules.title: Linking rules
rules.explain: A rule marks the suggestions it matches and fills in the kind and tax treatment their link records. You still confirm each link; a match with competitors is never filled in.
rules.sheetDescription: Rules that set how matching suggestions are linked, and views you saved earlier.
rules.failed: That change could not be saved.

table.conflictTitle: One of these transactions appears in {{count}} possible matches. Open the row to pick the right one — linking or dismissing resolves the others.
table.conflictHiddenTitle: {{count}} alternative match(es) are hidden by the current tab or filters.

preview.noPairsExact: No links were created. The candidates may already be linked, conflicted, or no longer match the current filters.
preview.noPairsSelected: No links were created. The selected candidates may already be linked or no longer match the current list.
preview.pairFailed: Could not link the selected candidates.

detail.rationalePaymentHash: Both legs share the same Lightning payment hash.
detail.rationaleProviderEvidence: Both legs share the same redacted provider swap id.
detail.rationaleHeuristic: The legs are close in time and amount after accounting for the fee delta.
detail.rationaleHtlcRefund: The inbound refund spends the outbound's on-chain HTLC funding output, a deterministic link even within one wallet.
detail.rationaleOwnershipGraph: The on-chain transaction proves a payment to another wallet you own. Confirming this card writes a normal carrying-value link; it does not invent a receipt.
detail.conflictNote_one: One of these transactions also appears in {{count}} other possible match (it may be filtered out). Select the related same-asset privacy links together, or link the correct single match here and dismiss the wrong ones.
detail.conflictNote_other: One of these transactions also appears in {{count}} other possible matches (they may be filtered out). Select the related same-asset privacy links together, or link the correct single match here and dismiss the wrong ones.
detail.deltasNote: Journal and tax deltas are computed on the next journal reprocess.
detail.layerTransitionOwnershipHint: Link a Bitcoin swap only when both sides are yours. If it paid someone else or received from someone else, leave it unlinked as a payment or receipt.

saveDialog.title: Save current filter as a view
saveDialog.description: The active confidence, method, and route filters are saved verbatim. Pick a short name; the chip appears at the top of the queue for one-click recall.

createRule.title: Create linking rule
createRule.description: Suggestions that match every field you set get the kind and tax treatment below when you link them. A match with competing matches is never filled in.
createRule.maxFee: Fee up to (% of the amount)

keymap.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keymap.description: Shortcuts work whenever the focus isn't in a text field.

bc1qexampleaddress…

reconcile.description: Paste addresses or transaction ids to find which belong to a wallet in this book — receive or change — and which are external. Useful for telling apart historic payments from transfers between your own wallets.
reconcile.onDeviceNote: Checked on this device against your wallets. Nothing leaves this machine unless you verify on chain.
reconcile.fileEmpty: That file is empty — nothing to import.

empty.owned: Derived from a wallet in this book, as a receive or change address with its index.
empty.external: Not derived from any of your wallets.
empty.unknown: Not in your synced history. Verify on chain to settle it.

reconcile.verifyHint: Asks {{backend}} about the entries your synced history cannot settle. This is the only step that leaves this device.
reconcile.listChanged: The list changed since this check. Check again to update the results; Verify on chain uses the checked list.

empty.title: Compare CoinTracking or Blockpit with Kassiber
empty.body: Pick the tool's transaction export. Kassiber reads it without importing anything and shows, wallet by wallet, which transactions differ or exist on only one side.

headline.nothingComparedDetail: The file and the book have no Bitcoin or L-BTC transactions in common scope.

notes.clock_offset: {{tool}} times are {{hours}} h from Kassiber's (UTC); the comparison allows for that.
notes.journals_stale: Journals are not current, so transaction types were not compared.
notes.tool_other_assets_one: {{count}} {{tool}} row in another asset was not compared.
notes.tool_other_assets_other: {{count}} {{tool}} rows in other assets were not compared.
notes.kassiber_other_assets_one: {{count}} Kassiber transaction in {{assets}} was not compared.
notes.kassiber_other_assets_other: {{count}} Kassiber transactions in {{assets}} were not compared.

tools.toolsDescription: Check a CoinTracking or Blockpit export against the book, wallet by wallet. Nothing is imported or changed.

revert.title: Edit reverted
revert.body: Kassiber wrote a new edit history entry with the reverted value.
revert.failedBody: Kassiber could not revert this edit. Nothing was changed.

egress.subtitle: Live RAM-only outbound ledger
egress.notMonitored: This page lists requests Kassiber's main process makes. Work handed to a separate program (the release check, the AI CLI broker and lightning-cli) is not listed, because that traffic leaves from a process this page cannot see.

details.notCapturedValue: Path, query values, request body, headers, credentials, descriptors, and AI prompts are discarded before the RAM buffer.

logs.ramNote: Local-only RAM buffer. Nothing is written to disk unless you export.

support.title: Export support bundle
support.description: Review the generated JSONL before saving.
support.highSignalDescription: Keeps addresses, paths, labels, URLs, and error text readable. Txids and amounts always become stable pseudonyms (amounts keep a coarse magnitude) — never the raw value.
support.publicSafeDescription: Masks operational fields after stripping wallet and credential material. Txids and amounts become stable pseudonyms with no magnitude.
support.notExportedBody: Add a short issue description first.

logs.exportRawConfirm: Export raw logs? They may contain sensitive local data.
logs.rawWarning: Raw logs are visible until {{time}}. Exports taken now are watermarked.

imports.description: Add watch-only wallet sources, node integrations, exchange imports, and local files.
imports.sourcesSubHeading: Choose the source type. Only watch-only or read-only flows belong here.

clear.title: Nothing to review
clear.body: Every transaction is booked and every suggested transfer is decided.

transfers.title: Suggested links
transfers.why: A linked transfer is not a sale. Unlinked, each side counts on its own.
transfers.failed: That did not work. Nothing was changed.
transfers.unavailable: Transfer suggestions could not be loaded.

bulk.body: Each becomes a transfer between your own wallets using carrying value. Taxable matches, competing candidates and ownership proofs stay for individual review. Each step includes up to 50 matches. You can undo it right after.
bulk.none: Nothing was linked: the exact matches changed. The list is up to date again.

transfers.policyNote: A swap that keeps the cost basis is tax-neutral; a taxable swap counts as a sale and a purchase at market value. Change it under Details.

policy.carryingHint: The cost basis carries over; only the fee is booked.
policy.taxableHint: Counted as a sale and a purchase at market value.

transfers.linkDifferentlyLabel: Link the send of {{route}} to another receipt
transfers.clearView: Show all suggestions instead of the view {{name}}

reason.provider: Same swap id from the provider
reason.ownership: Coins traced through your own wallets

transfersPage.title: Transfers
transfersPage.subtitle: Bitcoin moving between your own wallets, and swaps across on-chain, Lightning, Liquid and Ark.

verdict.settledBody_other: {{count}} transfers between your wallets are linked.
verdict.emptyBody: When Bitcoin moves between your wallets, or through a swap, it shows up here.
verdict.sortOutHeld: Tax reports wait until you answer.
verdict.sortOutSuggestions: Suggestions are only booked once you confirm them.

verdict.unavailableBody: Part of what waits on you could not be loaded, so this page can't say whether anything is left to sort out.

stats.label: Transfers at a glance
stats.sortOutHeld: Tax reports wait for your answer

sortOut.reports: Tax reports wait until each one is answered.
sortOut.unavailable: Transfers waiting for your answer could not be loaded.
sortOut.incomplete: There are more unlinked transfers and set-aside suggestions than this screen can read at once, so some transfers that wait for your answer may not be shown.

held.question: You unlinked this {{amount}} send from {{from}}.
held.why: The coins arrived in {{to}}, which you own, so Kassiber can't book it as a payment.
held.linkDifferently: It arrived somewhere else: choose the receipt…

gapHold.body: Kassiber holds it so it doesn't book coins you may still own as spent.
gapHold.locked: Resolving this needs the advanced tools. Turn on developer tools in Settings, or connect the wallet it came back through.

linked.title: Linked transfers
linked.unavailable: Linked transfers could not be loaded.
linked.partial: Some linked transfers could not be loaded, so this list may be incomplete.
linked.olderMayMatch: Older transfers aren't loaded yet and may match too.
linked.byRuleReason: Linked by one of your linking rules
linked.basisBlocked: Tax basis waits for an earlier transfer

linked.undoneReason: Kassiber won't link these again unless you link them back.
linked.fee: Network fee of the sending transaction: {{amount}}
linked.linkedByYouReason: You linked these two transactions yourself.

fixed.sameTransaction: One transaction seen by two of your wallets, so there is nothing to unlink.
fixed.fanout: One transaction paid several of your wallets, so there is nothing to unlink.
fixed.consolidation: Several of your wallets paid into one transaction, so there is nothing to unlink.
fixed.channel: Your wallet opened or closed this Lightning channel, and its transaction ties both sides, so there is nothing to unlink.
fixed.chain: Wallet or chain evidence ties both sides, so there is nothing to unlink.

linked.rest: {{left}} of the send is still unlinked.

undo.failed: The link could not be removed. Nothing was changed.

toast.unlinked: Unlinked. Kassiber now asks about the send under To sort out, or lists it under Unlinked by you.
toast.linkedBack: Linked again. Journals are being recalculated.
toast.unpaired: Unlinked. It's under Unlinked by you if you change your mind.
toast.linkBackFailed: The link could not be restored. Nothing was changed.

advanced.title: Advanced custody tools
advanced.description: For histories a simple link can't describe. Changes here are previewed and confirmed like any other review.

empty.suggestionsChecks: Kassiber checks every send against what arrived in your other wallets: the same transaction, payment hash or swap id, or the same amount less a usual fee within a day. Those it is sure of are linked for you; the rest wait here for you.
empty.suggestionsMissed: If it missed a transfer (a peg-out or swap with a larger fee, or a receipt days later), link it yourself with Link manually.
empty.linkedBody: When Bitcoin moves between your wallets, Kassiber links what it can prove and suggests the rest. You can also link two transactions yourself.

fee.none: Nothing was lost on the way.
fee.highLinkedFlag: More than 1% of the send: high for a transfer, usual for a peg-out or swap.
fee.mismatchLinkedFlag: The amounts don't match: more than 10% of the send didn't arrive.

policy.taxable: Counts as a sale and a purchase (taxable)

effects.checking: Recalculating your book with this change…
effects.unavailable: The preview could not be read.
effects.reportsReady: Tax reports are not held up by anything after this.
effects.reportsBlocked_one: Tax reports still wait for {{count}} held transaction after this.
effects.reportsBlocked_other: Tax reports still wait for {{count}} held transactions after this.
effects.checkingLong: This can take a minute on a large book. Nothing changes until you confirm.

unlink.title: Unlink this transfer?
unlink.subtitle: {{from}} → {{to}}
unlink.howAutomaticPlain: Automatically, when the journals were calculated.
unlink.howBulk: By you on {{date}}, with the other exact suggestions.
unlink.howRule: By one of your linking rules on {{date}}.
unlink.effectHeld: The send from {{from}} is held until you decide what it was. Kassiber doesn't book it as a payment, because the coins arrived in a wallet you own.
unlink.effectBooked: The send from {{from}} counts as a sale and the receipt in {{to}} as a purchase.
unlink.effectPair: The send from {{from}} will count as a sale and the receipt in {{to}} as a purchase, each at the market value of its day.
unlink.effectPairWhy: Kassiber doesn't hold them for a decision: nothing but your link says both wallets' coins are the same. If it has its own proof for this pair (the same exchange or Bark transaction), it links them again automatically.
unlink.noDryRun: Kassiber can't preview removing a link you made, so this is what it does today, not a preview. The journals are recalculated right after.
unlink.fixedFix: If one of these wallets isn't yours, remove or fix that wallet instead.
unlink.undoAutomatic: The transfer appears under Unlinked by you on this page, or under To sort out while it's held, with Link back. Kassiber won't link these two again by itself.
unlink.undoPair: The transfer appears under Unlinked by you on this page with Link again, which restores it with the same kind and tax treatment, whether or not Kassiber suggests it.
unlink.effectPairTaxable: Tax figures stay the same: this link already counted as a sale and a purchase. Kassiber only stops treating the two as one {{kind}}.
unlink.stale: Your book changed since this check, so nothing was unlinked. Kassiber is checking again.

unlinked.title: Unlinked by you
unlinked.hint: Each side counts on its own until you link it again.

link.title: Link manually
link.portion: Only {{amount}} of the send was swapped, as before.
link.portionUnsendable: The part of the send swapped before can't be restored exactly here, so this link can't be made again from this screen. Nothing was linked.
link.effectReleased: The send is no longer held.
link.effectStillHeld: One side is still held for another reason; it stays under To sort out.
link.failed: That did not work. Nothing was changed.
link.effectCreatesHolds_one: Linking these puts {{count}} transaction on hold. Tax reports wait until you resolve it.
link.effectCreatesHolds_other: Linking these puts {{count}} transactions on hold. Tax reports wait until you resolve them.
link.subtitle: Choose the send and the receipt that belong together. Nothing is linked until you confirm.

notice.unknown: That transaction isn't in this book. Choose both sides here.
notice.gone: A transaction of this link is no longer in this book. Choose that side again.

slot.pickSend: Choose the send from the list below
slot.pickReceipt: Choose the receipt from the list below

link.emptyNarrowed: Nothing matches the search and the time. Look through all of them instead.

diff.lessLong: {{amount}} less arrived than was sent ({{share}}% of the send).
diff.otherAssetLong: The two sides are different assets, so their amounts can't be compared.

warn.negative: More arrived than was sent. These are probably not the same coins.
warn.mismatch: The amounts don't match: no transfer or swap costs this much. Check that these are the same coins.
warn.high: That's more than 1% of the send: high for a transfer on one network.
warn.before: The receipt is dated before the send.
warn.sameWallet: Both sides are in the same wallet.
warn.sendLinked: The send is already linked. Kassiber may refuse a second link; unlink the first one then.
warn.sendLinkedTo: The send is already linked to {{wallet}}. Kassiber may refuse a second link; unlink the first one then.
warn.receiptLinked: The receipt is already linked. Kassiber may refuse a second link; unlink the first one then.
warn.receiptLinkedTo: The receipt is already linked to {{wallet}}. Kassiber may refuse a second link; unlink the first one then.
warn.sendIgnored: The send is excluded from this book. Include it again before you link it.
warn.receiptIgnored: The receipt is excluded from this book. Include it again before you link it.
warn.mismatchOrRest: Far less arrived than was sent. Either these are not the same coins, or the rest arrived in another transaction. If it did, link this part now and the rest right after.

link.limited: Showing the newest {{count}}. Search or pick a year to find older ones.
link.limitedWindow: Showing the newest {{count}} in this time. Search or shorten the time to find others.
link.waitingJournals: Waiting for the journals to finish recalculating…

refused.conflict: One of these two is already part of another link or review. Unlink that first.
refused.nothingLeft: Nothing of this send is left to link: its other links already cover it.
refused.network: These two are on different Bitcoin networks, so they can't be one transfer.
refused.notFound: One of these transactions is no longer in this book.
refused.terms: Kassiber can't link these two that way in this book. Choose the other answer.

link.stale: Your book changed since this check, so nothing was linked. Kassiber is checking again.
link.ownBitcoin: Moving your own bitcoin: no tax, and the cost basis carries over.
link.ownAsset: Moving your own coins: no tax, and the cost basis carries over.

question.title: Was this a sale?
question.keepBitcoinHint: No tax now. The cost basis carries over.
question.keepAssetHint: No tax now. The cost basis carries over to what you received.
question.sale: Yes, a sale and a purchase
question.saleHint: The send counts as sold and the receipt as bought, each at its day's value.
question.unanswered: Answer the question above to see what changes.

link.subtitleCheck: Check both sides and what changes. Nothing is linked until you confirm.
link.partNoteSend: {{linked}} of this send is already linked. This link is about the {{left}} that is left.
link.partNoteReceipt: {{linked}} of this receipt is already linked. This link is about the {{left}} that is left.
link.searchedReceipts: No receipt within {{span}} of the send.
link.searchedSends: No send within {{span}} before the receipt.
link.onlyReceipts: Not here? Only receipts within {{span}} of the send are listed.
link.onlySends: Not here? Only sends within {{span}} before the receipt are listed.
link.onlySale: A sale and a purchase: the send counts as sold and the receipt as bought, each at its day's value.

onlyWhy.crossAsset: Your book's tax rules count a swap into another asset as a sale, so there is nothing to choose.
onlyWhy.network: Kassiber's records don't agree on which Bitcoin network these two are on, so the cost basis can't carry over.

link.partAfter: After this link, {{amount}} of the send is still unlinked.
link.partDone: This link covers the rest of the send.
link.restOnly: Can't take the rest of a transfer: this would be a swap or a change of network. Unlink the first link to choose it.

setAside.hint: Restore one to see it as a suggestion again.

rowMenu.label: More for {{route}}
rowMenu.saySent: Sent to someone else? Say what it was…
rowMenu.sayReceived: Received from someone else? Say what it was…

strip.linkedRest: Linked. {{left}} of the send is still unlinked.

restHold.title: {{rest}} of your send from {{from}} isn't linked to a receipt yet.
restHold.body: What you linked it to received much less than was sent. Tax reports wait until the rest is accounted for.
restHold.linkRest: It arrived in another transaction: link the rest…
restHold.locked: If something else happened to the rest, turn on developer tools in Settings to say what.
